title: F1 Manager 2024
provenance: Reported by bethstibbles (highball#234, 2026-10-01), Apple M1, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.35, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer. yusancky (highball-db#1312, 2026-11-18), Apple M5, macOS 27.3, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 154 minutes: named F1® Manager 2024 in the report with no Steam id, taken to be the Steam release (2591280).
notes: Installed through Highball's Epic support with the Visual C++ runtimes, then crashed at the copyright screen, where the game starts its intro video, without writing a log of its own. Just before the crash the graphics layer printed 'Invalid device handle' for a shared texture, the failure engines before r13 had when a game and its video player share a texture. Engines since r13 no longer fail that texture. Whether that was the whole crash was not measured, and the reporter did not test again. A later report rates it perfect on an M5 with DXMT on the default engine r28 over 154 minutes, past the copyright screen (highball-db#1312).

knownIssues.symptom: Crash at the copyright screen (reported on an M1, macOS 26.6.2, engine of Highball 0.9.35)
knownIssues.cause: likely the shared texture between the game and its intro video, which engines before r13 failed to open
knownIssues.fix: update Highball, engines r13 and later open that texture. A later report played 154 minutes on the default engine r28 with DXMT on an M5 (highball-db#1312)
